description: This file declares utility functions for file operations such as checking existence, copying, renaming, reading, and directory management within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes function prototypes for handling files, directories, and paths, as well as some platform-specific functions and path emulation utilities.
external_methods: Result<std::string> CreateHardLink(const std::string&, const std::string&, bool)
Result<void> EnsureDirectoryExists(const std::string&, const mode_t, const std::string&)
Result<void> WalkDirectory(const std::string&, const std::function<bool(const std::string&)>&)

classes.name: FileSizes
classes.description: A struct representing the sizes of a file, including sparse size and disk size.

classes.name: InputPathForm
classes.description: A struct used to specify parameters for path emulation, including optional current working directory, home directory, the path to convert, and whether to follow symlinks.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path, optionally following symlinks.

methods.name: FileDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID of the file at the specified path.

methods.name: CanHardLink
methods.description: Determines if a hard link can be created between source and destination.

methods.name: FileInodeNumber
methods.description: Gets the inode number of the file at the given path.

methods.name: AreHardLinked
methods.description: Checks if two files are hard linked.

methods.name: CreateHardLink
methods.description: Creates a hard link to a target file at the specified hardlink path, with optional overwrite.

methods.name: FileHasContent
methods.description: Checks if the file at the given path has content.

methods.name: DirectoryContents
methods.description: Lists the contents of a directory.

methods.name: DirectoryExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the specified path.

methods.name: EnsureDirectoryExists
methods.description: Ensures that a directory exists, creating it if necessary, with specified permissions and group.

methods.name: ChangeGroup
methods.description: Changes the group ownership of a file or directory.

methods.name: CanAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current process has access to a file with specified mode.

methods.name: IsDirectoryEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a directory is empty.

methods.name: RecursivelyRemoveDirectory
methods.description: Removes a directory and all its contents recursively.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies a file from one location to another.

methods.name: FileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a file.

methods.name: RemoveFile
methods.description: Removes a file.

methods.name: RenameFile
methods.description: Renames or moves a file.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string.

methods.name: ReadFileContents
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file, returning a Result.

methods.name: MakeFileExecutable
methods.description: Sets the executable permission on a file.

methods.name: FileModificationTime
methods.description: Gets the last modification time of a file.

methods.name: FileIsSocket
methods.description: Checks if a file is a Unix socket.

methods.name: GetDiskUsage
methods.description: Calculates disk usage for a path, including all files under a directory.

methods.name: FindImage
methods.description: Searches for an image file matching patterns in a directory.

methods.name: AbsolutePath
methods.description: Converts a path to an absolute path.

methods.name: CurrentDirectory
methods.description: Returns the current working directory.

methods.name: SparseFileSizes
methods.description: Returns the sparse and disk sizes of a file.

methods.name: FindFile
methods.description: Finds a file with a specific name under a directory.

methods.name: WalkDirectory
methods.description: Recursively walks through a directory, executing a callback on each entry.

methods.name: WaitForFile
methods.description: Waits for a file to appear, with a timeout.

methods.name: WaitForUnixSocket
methods.description: Waits for a Unix socket to appear, with a timeout.

methods.name: WaitForUnixSocketListeningWithoutConnect
methods.description: Waits for a Unix socket to be listening without establishing a connection.

methods.name: EmulateAbsolutePath
methods.description: Emulates an absolute path based on process/thread context and path parameters.
